fire:
Update your packages with the following command:
sudo apt-get update

Install the server by running:
sudo apt install nginx

Restart the service with this command:
sudo systemctl restart apache2

Make the script executable with:
$ chmod +x install.sh

First, upgrade pip using the following command:
sudo pip install --upgrade pip

To create the folder, type:
$ mkdir -p /opt/app

Add the user to the group with:
sudo usermod -aG docker alice

Then reboot the machine with the following command:
sudo reboot
